config.time_semantics: exact snapshots; no time averaging or interpolation

notes: Payload sizes exclude NetCDF/HDF5 overhead; compressed size requires the pilot.
Source size counts discovered history files, not the entire experiment directories.
Support fields are additional to the requested primary variables.
Surface mode keeps the lowest mass layer and its two interfaces, not fixed-height air quality.
RAINC/RAINNC remain accumulated values; this tool does not compute interval rainfall.
